paper_title: Axion Dark Matter from Cosmic String Network
notes: Eq.(21): lattice-simulation-based lower bound on the post-inflationary QCD axion mass from requiring the string-radiated axion abundance not exceed Omega h^2=0.12: m_a >~ 420 ueV (fat-string pre-evolution, reported here as the conservative main result) and m_a >~ 470 ueV (thermal pre-evolution). Equivalently f_a/N_W <= 1.3e10 GeV (fat-string) via m_a = 5.7 ueV (1e12 GeV / f_a), the same convention as the canonical AxionMass plane. The bound is a single point on the QCD line (masses below 420 ueV / f_a above 1.36e10 GeV, i.e. 1/f_a below 7.4e-11 GeV^-1, overproduce dark matter); the curve reported traces the QCD line 1/f_a = m_a/(5.7 ueV) x 1e-12 GeV^-1 up to the bound endpoint at 4.2e-4 eV. No statistical confidence level is quoted in the paper (0.95 entered as placeholder). Cosmological abundance bound, no local DM density assumed.
